tests.name: cross-origin 302 is cancelled without reading its body or forwarding credentials
proper stop + DONE returns exact content and usage-only final event
one-byte chunks preserve split UTF-8 and every event boundary
CRLF event boundaries survive arbitrary transport splits
SSE comments/empty events and multiline JSON data are accepted
no usage remains unknown rather than zero
inconsistent reported usage is not marked trustworthy
missing DONE is rejected after otherwise proper stop
DONE without stop is rejected
empty content with stop and DONE is rejected
explicit output truncation is rejected
tool_calls delta is rejected
legacy function_call delta is rejected
multiple choices in one event are rejected
nonzero choice index is rejected
provider content-filter refusal is rejected
content emitted after stop is rejected
extra data event after DONE in same transport chunk is rejected
malformed JSON event is rejected
invalid UTF-8 is an invalid response rather than a network failure
output character bound rejects oversized generated text
total transport byte bound rejects oversized SSE metadata/comments
caller cancellation stops stalled stream reader
transport timeout stops stalled reader
cancellation retains usage already reported by stream
normal JSON fallback works even when request opted into stream
normal nonstream JSON request preserves compatibility

scope: Actual TypeScript transport bundled with esbuild; mocked fetch and ReadableStream only. No model quality, latency or provider-compatibility claim.
